source: Owner playtests, 2026-10-23/24: ordinary trainers must follow every zone and actual completed Tactica story roster
scope: Ordinary HnS trainers, including rematches and grunts; canonical bosses and special encounters are protected
zone_floor: Highest minimum level among canonical standard encounter tables on this map; interiors without tables inherit the lowest mapped floor in their region-map section
story_floor: Highest minimum roster level of each completed non-Rocket Gym, Rival (including the opening Cherrygrove duel) or League roster; partial central Kanto Gym groups count each individual victory immediately. Champion flags establish their League floor. Player-cap group locks are separate.
party_levels: Raise the lowest authored level to max(authored minimum, zone floor, story floor); preserve offsets within max(zone ceiling, story floor), never lower an authored level, clamp at 100
species_and_moves: Resolve deterministic level evolutions at the resulting level and adapt explicit moves to that species/level; item and other conditional evolutions remain authored
difficulty: Same levels in NORMAL/HARD and with any player level-cap setting; never depend on the player's party level
